evals.prompt: This is a multi-tenant SaaS backend under evals/files/sample-repo. Audit it for cross-tenant data leaks: establish the tenancy model, inventory the data-access paths, and find every place one tenant could reach another tenant's data. Write findings in the standard format.
evals.expected_output: Tenancy model (shared DB, TenantId column, tenant from token claim) and a tenant-context flow diagram, a data-access-path inventory flagging unscoped paths, and TENANT findings covering all five planted issues: (1) InvoicesController.Report raw SQL + IgnoreQueryFilters returns all tenants; (2) CreateInvoiceDto.TenantId taken from the body; (3) NightlyBillingJob runs with no tenant context; (4) DocumentsController.Get cache key document:{id} has no tenant segment; (5) DocumentsController.Download blob path has no tenant folder. Negatives (InvoicesController.List global filter, CreateSafe, DocumentsController.Thumbnail, TenantAwareJob) are not flagged.
expectations: States the tenancy model is shared-database with a TenantId column and tenant resolved from the token claim
Produces a tenant-context flow diagram (resolution -> propagation -> enforcement)
Flags the raw SQL + IgnoreQueryFilters in InvoicesController.Report as returning all tenants' data
Flags CreateInvoiceDto/Create taking TenantId from the request body
Flags NightlyBillingJob for running with no tenant context
Flags the DocumentsController.Get cache key that omits the tenant id
Flags the DocumentsController.Download blob path that omits a tenant segment
Does NOT flag InvoicesController.List, CreateSafe, DocumentsController.Thumbnail, or TenantAwareJob
All finding ids start with TENANT-

evals.prompt: We have a staging environment with two throwaway tenants and a token for each. Build the data-access-path inventory for evals/files/sample-repo and produce the cross-tenant probe command that, as tenant A, tries to read, write, list, search, download and export tenant B's data including with a tampered tenant id. Do not fabricate results.
evals.expected_output: Runs data_access_paths.py and audit-endpoint-inventory, turns endpoints.probe.json into an endpoints.json in tenant_probe.py's shape (id_params and operation from the inventory, tamper body/query with {tenant_b} added) and a tenants.json template, and prints the exact tenant_probe.py invocation (--base-url, --tenants, --endpoints, --tenant-header). States the probe covers read/write/list/search/download/export and tampered tenant identifiers, only runs when a URL is supplied, and targets a disposable environment; does not invent pass/fail rows.
expectations: Uses scripts/data_access_paths.py to inventory data-access paths
Emits an endpoint inventory in tenant_probe.py's shape with operations and id_params, taken from audit-endpoint-inventory's endpoints.probe.json
Shows the tenant_probe.py command covering read/write/list/search/download/export and tampered ids
Explicitly says the probe only runs when the user supplies a URL and targets a disposable test environment
